有效值：
disabled：表示禁用LiveChannel。
enabled：表示启用LiveChannel

Url.description_en:
The streaming URL.

The streaming URL is an unsigned URL. If the bucket ACL is not public-read-write, you must sign the URL before you can access it.
The playback URL is an unsigned URL. If the bucket ACL is private, you must sign the URL before you can access it

推流地址。

推流地址是未加签名的URL，如Bucket ACL非public-read-write，则需先进行签名才可访问。
播放地址是未加签名的URL，如Bucket ACL为private，则需先进行签名才可访问

name: ListLiveChannel

parameters.help_en: Specifies that results are returned starting from the first LiveChannel alphabetically after the marker value
parameters.help_zh: 设定结果从marker之后按字母排序的第一个开始返回
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of LiveChannels to return. The value of max-keys cannot exceed 1000.
Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
限定此次返回LiveChannel的最大数。max-keys取值不能大于1000。
默认值：100
parameters.name: max_keys

parameters.help_en: Specifies that only LiveChannels whose names contain the specified prefix are returned. When you use prefix for a query, the returned keys still contain the prefix
parameters.help_zh: 限定返回的LiveChannel必须以prefix作为前缀。注意使用prefix查询时，返回的key中仍会包含prefix
parameters.name: prefix

schema.description_en: The response body that contains the results of the ListLiveChannel request
schema.description_zh: 保存ListLiveChannel请求结果的响应体

ListLiveChannelResult.description_en: The container that stores the results of the ListLiveChannel request

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether all results are returned.

true: All results are returned in this request.

false: Not all results are returned in this request
IsTruncated.description_zh:
是否已返回所有的结果。

true：表示本次请求已返回全部结果。

false：表示本次请求未返回全部结果

LiveChannel.description_en: The list of returned LiveChannel information
LiveChannel.description_zh: 保存返回的LiveChannel信息的列表

items.description_en: The container that stores the LiveChannel information

Marker.description_en: The marker from which the ListLiveChannel operation starts

MaxKeys.description_en: The maximum number of results returned in the response
MaxKeys.description_zh: 响应请求内返回结果的最大数目

NextMarker.description_en: If not all results are returned, the response includes the NextMarker element to indicate the Marker value for the next request
NextMarker.description_zh: 如果本次没有返回全部结果，响应请求中将包含NextMarker元素，用于标明接下来请求的Marker值

Prefix.description_en: The prefix used to filter the query results
Prefix.description_zh: 本次查询结果的开始前缀
